decision: Thomas, 15 Nov 2026, Europe/Copenhagen: the narrator for 6 Things EP01 is en-US-AndrewNeural. This supersedes the bm_daniel decision of 12 Nov 2026. bm_daniel remains the narrator of Inside the Log EP05 and later; do not change those episodes.
engine: Chatterbox TTS zero-shot clone (primary), or Microsoft Edge TTS (fallback)

reference.note: 12.096 s, 48 kHz stereo 16-bit (dual mono), of the Andrew voice. Used as the clone reference. No training is involved.

chatterbox.note: No CUDA or DirectML acceleration: chatterbox pins torch 2.6.0 and AMD DirectML on Windows stops at torch 2.4. Render speed is about 5x realtime on a Ryzen 7 9800X3D.

edge.note: Calls Microsoft's en-US-AndrewNeural directly. About 0.5x realtime and reproduces the original voice exactly, because there is no clone step.

input: text after the TEXT_RESPELLS and NORM tables. Neither engine takes phonemes, so the Kokoro phoneme fixes (Betaflight, Fresnel, lexicon) are applied as text respells instead.

sentence_handling.why: Chatterbox slurs the end of long text and once looped for over nine minutes on a 22-word chunk. A sentence at or below 15 words is therefore passed through whole, keeping its own commas and rhythm. A longer sentence is split at , ; : then before conjunctions then at a word boundary, and the pieces are merged back greedily so no tiny fragment is left alone. An earlier version split at every comma and audibly mangled 'A motor, a bearing, maybe the flight controller itself.' into three fragments; that is why the passthrough rule exists.

caching.key: sha256 of engine, voice, settings, reference-file hash and the exact sentence
caching.why: Each synthesized sentence is cached so an interrupted run resumes instead of starting over. The machine went down mid-render once.

loudnorm.note: Same two-pass ffmpeg loudnorm as the previous chain. Delivery is 48 kHz 24-bit WAV + 192 kb/s MP3.

timing_policy: The timing CSV written by the renderer is the single source of truth. scene-index.json and the chapter list in RELEASE_DRAFTS.md are derived from it and never hand-edited. Run sync_timing.py after every render.
length_note: Measured full track is 12:45 (764.894 s), about 13 percent shorter than the previous bm_daniel audio at 14:35 (875.793 s), because the Andrew voice paces faster. Picture is cut to the measured sheet; audio is never stretched to chase an old runtime. Full-track loudness is -16.4 LUFS integrated with a -1.4 dBTP true peak.

ep1_to_ep4.note: Provenance only. Do not retouch EP4 Part 2 or earlier audio.
